name: FB0929-line-uncut-at-the-call
note: The readout hands the path no screen: a far pick's dashed line runs a million pixels off it again, every frame.

name: FB0929-margin-inside-the-casing
note: Cut a pixel off the screen: the casing's round cap at the cut (half its 6 px) stands on the screen's edge.

name: FB0929-no-screen-cuts-anyway
note: No screen given, a line off the top-left is cut anyway - TV2's law was to cut nothing.

name: FB0929-first-point-written-off-the-screen
note: The first point past the eye is written wherever it projects - hundreds of thousands of pixels out.

name: FB0929-no-move-where-it-comes-back
note: A line coming onto the screen starts no stroke of its own, and one on it breaks at every point.

name: FB0929-stroke-joined-across-the-gap
note: A line gone off the screen still reads as on it: where the route comes back, a straight line is drawn across whatever lay between.

name: FB0929-endpoint-reckoned-not-written
note: A point on the screen written as a + (b - a) x 1: from the margin to x 6.5 that is 6.4999... and rounds to 6 - no longer the line it was, byte for byte.

name: FB0929-right-edge-from-the-wrong-side
note: The right edge reckoned from the wrong side: a line out through it keeps its far end.

name: FB0929-coming-on-keeps-its-far-start
note: A line coming onto the screen is never cut where it enters: its start stays hundreds of thousands of pixels out.

name: FB0929-going-off-keeps-its-far-end
note: A line going off the screen is never cut where it leaves: the million pixels back, dashed.

name: FB0929-along-an-edge-refused
note: A line straight up or straight across the screen is refused inside it and kept outside it.

name: FB0929-corner-miss-drawn-coming-on
note: A line passing a corner of the screen, coming on after it has gone off, is drawn backwards past the corner.

name: FB0929-corner-miss-drawn-going-off
note: A line passing a corner of the screen, going off before it has come on, is drawn backwards past the corner.
